method.allocator: Default environment throughout. No MALLOC_ or GLIBC_ tunables and no LD_PRELOAD.
method.timing: CPU 2, one partition, 1048576 rows, batch size 8192, two warmups, nine measured executions. Each case has 12 fresh processes per variant in balanced order. Counters and samples come from the SAME nine-execution interval, with FIFO control and 100% counter running time. Counter totals include the phase handshake and loop bookkeeping.
method.sampling_unit: Each process contributes its median execution time to the reported process median and mean. Individual nine samples remain recorded but are not treated as nine independent fresh-process observations.
method.measurement_order: 72 wrapped-query processes reused the exact preceding binaries. The native-output experiment rebuilt all three variants from identical benchmark source, checked all values, then ran 144 processes. Builds and correctness checks completed before their measurements. Tracing ran separately.
method.tracing: 24 completed strace runs, 12 wrapped and 12 native. FIFO write markers isolate benchmark execution. brk/mmap/munmap/madvise counts reflect those intervals. Traced timings and tracer-inclusive perf counters are diagnostic and are excluded from performance comparisons.
